title: EON Resources Inc. 8-K Filing — Notice of Delisting or Failure to Satisfy Continued Listing Rule or Standard; Transfer of Listing
summary: EON Resources Inc. received a notice of noncompliance from NYSE American on April 16, 2026, for failure to timely file its Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025. The company has until October 15, 2026 to cure the deficiency. The notification has no immediate effect on the listing of the company's securities.
key_points: EON Resources Inc. received NYSE American noncompliance notice on April 16, 2026
Company failed to file Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 by the April 15, 2026 deadline
Initial Cure Period extends to October 15, 2026; additional six-month period may be granted at NYSE's discretion
Company is an emerging growth company as defined by SEC Rule 405
Class A Common Stock trades on NYSE American under symbol EONR
The notification has no immediate effect on the listing status
